criteria.live_only: Keep caret out of snapshots entirely and serve it through two explicit calls: read_selection(node) fetches the live selection record and set_selection(node, start, end, direction) stores one. Handlers needing caret pay one read each, and every snapshot avoids the caret field.
criteria.snapshot_only: Embed a nested selection record (start, end, direction) in each dispatched event snapshot and supply set_selection(node, start, end, direction) as the single live caret writer. Skip a live caret reader: dispatch-time observation plus the setter covers normalization and restore with the smallest call surface.
criteria.symmetric_calls: Embed the nested selection record in snapshots and also expose read_selection(node) beside set_selection(node, start, end, direction), so caret can be sampled at dispatch and again afterwards for save-time reads, focus repair and async flows through one matched reader/writer pair.

caret_projection.instructions: What caret and selection projection best fits the Can browser boundary and its normalization workflows?

criteria.flag_only: Record the native isComposing flag as a composing boolean on input and key snapshots, adding zero event kinds. Handlers skip normalization while the flag holds and infer composition edges from successive input events.
criteria.flag_plus_end: Record the composing boolean on current snapshots and recognize compositionend alone as a new event kind, handing handlers a direct commit marker in addition to the flag while leaving start and update out.
criteria.new_kinds: Recognize compositionstart, compositionupdate and compositionend as event kinds whose snapshots hold the composing boolean and a data string with native event.data, while input events keep carrying the flag for flag-style handling.

composition_signal.instructions: Through which channel should IME composition information arrive at Can handlers?

criteria.metadata_records: Deliver chosen files on change events as file records carrying name, size and mime, and answer read_files(node) with the identical shape. Document a bound of the first 128 entries in selection order; bytes remain outside the boundary.
criteria.names_only: Deliver chosen files as bare name strings in snapshots and from read_files(node), omitting size and mime. The narrowest projection, giving up pre-upload size and type checks.
criteria.opaque_handles: Deliver chosen files as opaque handle tokens inside snapshots and resolve name, size and mime through read_file_metadata(handle). The tokens anticipate upload operations that no present workflow consumes.

file_projection.instructions: What file-selection projection should the Can browser boundary provide?

criteria.chord_string: Encode held modifiers into a single sorted chord string on each event, concatenating names with '+' in alt, ctrl, meta, shift sequence ('', 'ctrl', 'ctrl+shift'). Minimal field count, with per-modifier checks done by string matching.
criteria.flat_bools: Place four booleans (alt_key, ctrl_key, meta_key, shift_key) at the event top level. This avoids inventing a catalogue type while widening every snapshot by four fields.
criteria.nested_record: Place one modifiers record holding alt, ctrl, meta and shift booleans on the event. This adds a single catalogue type plus a single event field, and per-modifier checks become ordinary nested field reads.

modifier_shape.instructions: In which shape should browser event snapshots project held modifier keys?

state.boundary: Can browser events at 27338b09 project four snapshot fields, kind, target, value and key, across nine recognized kinds: click, dblclick, input, change, keydown, keyup, focus, blur, submit. Control writes reach attributes only, so setAttribute revises the default while live dirty input text survives (probed); checkbox change snapshots match whether checked or not, always showing value 'on' (probed). The boundary projects no caret, modifiers, composition, multiselect choices or files, and supplies no live value or checked writers.
state.contract: Under R02 interface C-D every addition arrives as one catalogue, checker and adapter slice with a bounded immutable projection: immutable records frozen synchronously when dispatched, live writers accepting explicit values, and caret or selection behavior behind explicit calls. Snapshot growth stays purely additive, leaving the four established fields semantically untouched. Collection results come back as fresh copies that cannot leak mutation. Listener lifetimes scoped to views and disposal behavior remain as selected. With zero external users, legacy compatibility imposes nothing beyond that additive snapshot rule.
state.evidence: Validation pairs native-DOM legs with emitted-Can legs on Chromium 140.0.7339.186, WebKit 26.0 and Firefox 141.0 via the container runner, exercising dirty value and checked reset, autofill observation, each projected field, absence of mutable escape, and the intact pre-existing snapshot legs.
state.fixed: Settled before this round and not reopened: a checked boolean plus a selected string array among snapshot fields; live writers set_value, set_checked and set_selected; live readers read_value, read_checked, read_selected and read_files. Still open: caret handling across snapshots and calls, file projection form, modifier-key form, and the composition signal.
state.workflows: Supported all-Can workflows drive the choice: caret-preserving input normalization; resetting dirty values and checked state to defaults; observing autofill; multiselect selection, reading and reset; reading upload file choices; deferring normalization across IME composition; repairing focus and caret after rerender; shift+click range selection over the keyed table; reordering rows; disposing views independently; and late replies that must not overwrite fresher edits.
